subclass_e_plus_plus_definition.name: e++ (3rd-order self-fabrication)
subclass_e_plus_plus_definition.definition: Full cycle of fabrication → propagation → contamination → recovery, where the recovering Muse is the same as the fabricating Muse
distinguishing_features: Requires ALL 3 steps (fabrication + propagation + recovery); PH-1/PH-2 require only fabrication; PH-3 requires only propagation; PH-4 requires only at-canonical state
Self-referential: the catch IS the codification (the recovery spec cites the original fabrication as a dependency)
Detection signature: 2-condition (same Muse author for fabrication+recovery) AND (recovery spec cite-bundle includes fabrication spec)
